name: Arc
statusNote: The Browser Company states on the Arc download page that Arc receives Chromium updates only and directs users to Dia for active security patches; builds remain downloadable.

android.note: Arc Search is available on Android, but is a distinct mobile product experience.

ios.note: Arc Search is available on iOS, but is a distinct mobile product experience.

availability.cpuNotes: Check current help documentation for supported desktop architecture.
availability.installMethod: Official desktop download or mobile app store.

foundation.codeLicense: Chromium base with proprietary Arc interface and services

telemetry.note: Arc documents account, diagnostics, and product data in its privacy materials.

trackerBlocking.note: Arc includes browser-level blocking controls, with scope set by product defaults.

fingerprintingProtections.note: No hardened anti-fingerprinting posture is claimed here.

privacy.privateWindows: Private browsing limits local data but does not create anonymity.

vpnOrProxy.note: No general browser VPN is included.

manifestV2.note: Chromium extension support follows current Chromium APIs.

extensions.limitations: Arc's spaces and sidebar can change how extensions present UI compared with Chrome.

nativeContentBlocking.note: Browser blocking controls are native; do not treat them as a universal blocker guarantee.

verticalTabs.note: Arc's sidebar is a vertical tab and space workflow.

tabTrees.note: Nested folders of pinned tabs give the sidebar a hierarchy.

workspaces.note: Spaces are central to Arc's organization model.

profiles.note: Profiles and spaces separate browsing contexts.

splitView.note: Split View with horizontal and vertical layouts is documented for macOS and Windows.

sidebar.note: The sidebar is the primary navigation surface.

readerMode.note: Reader features are available in Arc's page tools.

sync.note: Arc syncs supported spaces and browser data through its account model.

translation.note: A built-in translation feature is documented.

iosEngine.note: Apple permits alternative engines in the EU and Japan under entitlement; the shipping iOS build renders with WebKit.

assistant.note: Arc Max provides a built-in assistant surface.

summarization.note: Arc Max documents page or multi-tab summarisation.

aiSearch.note: An AI answer engine is not documented.

aiPrivacyControls.note: AI privacy controls are not documented.

voiceMultimodal.note: Voice or image interaction is not documented.

dataSaver.note: No documented data-saving or compression mode.

mobileExtensions.note: Extension support on mobile is not documented.

downloadManager.note: A built-in download manager is not documented.

backgroundMedia.note: Background or picture-in-picture playback is not documented.

webPush.note: Web push support is not documented.
